files.description: Website clicks (500 rows): click_ref (seven-digit reference with leading zeros, e.g. "0000011"), epoch_s (Unix timestamp in seconds, UTC, whole number), epoch_ms (Unix timestamp in milliseconds, UTC, when the click was received, whole number), page (site path such as /home or /pricing), dwell_s (seconds on the page, one decimal; about 8% empty).

task_text: Find the median moment at which the clicks were received, using epoch_ms (Unix time in milliseconds). `result` should be that moment as a timestamp (UTC, without time zone).
intended_computation: Take the median of the 500 epoch_ms values (average of the two middle values) and return it as a timezone-naive UTC timestamp in 2025.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the integer cast of a date-time made from milliseconds is not in nanoseconds, so the median lands in 1970

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
